annotation.title_clean: Circular RSV: Documentation requirements and principles for administrative processing of autonomous and remotely operated ships
annotation.title_en: Circular: Documentation requirements and principles for administrative processing of autonomous and remotely operated ships
named_instruments_referenced: Norwegian Ship Safety and Security Act
annotation.summary_en: Norwegian Maritime Authority circular setting documentation and approval requirements for autonomous (levels 3–5) and remotely operated ships on domestic voyages. Applies existing ship legislation plus IMO MSC.1/Circ.1455 equivalence process, requiring equal safety to conventional ships through CONOPS, HAZID, minimum risk conditions, FMEA, testing and third-party verification.
key_provisions_or_claims: Applies to ships with autonomy levels 3–5 on Norwegian domestic voyages; existing ship-type legislation is the baseline.
Equivalence assessed via IMO MSC.1/Circ.1455 with GAP analysis and risk assessment of deviations.
Requires CONOPS, pre-HAZID, safety, design and operation/maintenance philosophies; at least two MRCs in normal operation.
Third-party verification (typically classification society) required for novel, complex or high-risk deviations.
Model tests, full-scale tests in NMA-approved areas, FMEA, certified safety management system and NMA-approved control centre and operators.
